content:
pato: Quick planning thread — launch week checklist. We want 3 social bursts, a short benchmark clip (30s), and a webinar. Main experiment: immediate vs delayed credit + prompt-template timing. Keep measurement windows 24h & 7d.

rhea: Drafting social copy now. Two credit arms: INSTANT = 600 on signup, DELAYED = 200 on confirm + 1000 unlocked after first successful request within 7d. Control = none. Randomize 45/45/10.

jin: Pseudocode for Segment rule (short):
```
variant = chooseVariant(user.id)
identify(user.id, {launch_variant: variant})
if (variant == 'INSTANT') post('/hooks/credit-immediate', {user_id, amount:600, req_id})
```
Include idempotency token.

pato: Webinar flow: register -> confirm -> reminder 1h/15m -> live. Attendees get 1200 + promptpack. Non-attenders get 300 if they watch recording within 48h. Route high-fit leads (company_size >=50 OR intent_score >=0.7) to SDR via /hooks/sdr.

ops-bot: Staging hooks deployed: /hooks/credit-immediate, /hooks/credit-delayed, /hooks/sdr. Smoke test: hook_smoke_9001, logs: https://ops.internal/tests/hook_smoke_9001 :white_check_mark: 

rhea: Creative ask: 30s benchmark script + 3 caption variants for X and 1 LI longread. Keep PH blurb under 120 words. I'll drop copies by EOD.

sam: Tracking: emit events launch_signup, launch_confirm, credit_granted, first_success, promptpack_sent, webinar_attend. Tag with variant and utm_campaign. Dashboards: 24h & 7d activation, tokens_per_activation, credit burn.

jin: Action items: rhea -> copy + promptpack; jin -> Segment rule + webhook tests; pato -> confirm SDR criteria; ops-bot -> link smoke logs. Reconvene tomorrow 10am PT to sign off. :rocket:
